notes.title: Welcome back to Erstwhile!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome Back to the Erstwhile Annual LARP Event![/h1]

After nearly two years, and numerous requests for changes, the team decided to give [b][i]Guardian[/i][/b] a much needed rework. Since most of the original team had moved on, we dug into our player feedback and spent a lot of time and effort to try bringing you what you had requested.

After several months of rebalancing, repolishing, and reinvigorating [b][i]Guardian[/i][/b] to give you the best possible experience, Black Banshee Studios is proud to commence the Erstwhile Annual LARP Event, and we invite you to enjoy the new and (hopefully) improved [b][i]Guardian[/i][/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42616950/d72cbf3c2afbd3e8ae4d91315fee093b93cbc42f.png[/img]
[h2]Key Updates[/h2]

[list]
[*] New Enemies
[*] New Bosses
[*] Additional Music Tracks
[*] New Artwork, Animations, and Effects
[*] A fully functioning shop
[*] X-Box [u]and[/u] PlayStation Controller Support
[*] Expanded Upgrade System
[*] Improved Level Design
[/list]
